The indicator of a tab of charts

Source: R/layout-tab_panels.R
cd_tab_indicator.Rd

The serverInput function given to cd_tabbed_charts_server() receives the indicator of its tab as a string, and for the Custom tab as a reactive that returns the indicator the reader chose. cd_tab_indicator() gives one way to read both.

Usage

cd_tab_indicator(indicator)

Arguments

indicator

What serverInput received: an indicator's code, or a reactive that returns one.

Value

A function with no arguments that returns the indicator's code. For the Custom tab it must be called where a reactive can be read (in a reactive(), a render function or a plot_fun).

Examples

ind <- cd_tab_indicator("penta3")
ind()
#> [1] "penta3"

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# in a page's server: one serverInput for the indicators' tabs and the Custom tab
cd_tabbed_charts_server("panel",
  serverInput = function(id, current_indicator) {
    ind <- cd_tab_indicator(current_indicator)
    cd_coverage_plot_server(
      id = id,
      filename = reactive(paste0(ind(), "_coverage")),
      data_fn = reactive(cache()$get_filtered_coverage(ind(), "national")),
      sheet_name = reactive(i18n$t(paste0("opt_", ind()))),
      i18n = i18n
    )
  }
)
} # }
